pros: Earn up to 3 miles per dollar in every statement cycle where a min. eligible spend of S$2,000 is made.
pros: Complimentary Priority Pass membership with 6 lounge visits a year.
pros: Receive complimentary travel insurance coverage of up to S$1 million when you charge your full travel fare to this card.

extra.description: Arm yourself with the Standard Chartered Visa Infinite Card before your next trip, and look forward to up to 3 miles per S$1 overseas spend, along with complimentary airport lounge visits, S$1 million in complimentary travel insurance and more!
